intent: Brief supplementary text on hover or focus of a trigger element.
useWhen: Explaining an icon or abbreviated label
Non-critical context that should not clutter the layout
Which one: Tooltip names a control in a few words; HelpPopover explains it in one to three sentences; Popover holds fields or actions and takes focus. None of them is a menu or a blocking decision.
doNotUseWhen: Essential instructions — put them in visible hint text via Field
A sentence or two of help — use HelpPopover
Large content or forms — use Modal

placement.note: Preferred side. Flips to the other side when there is no room and stays inside the viewport.

delay.note: Hover waits; focus shows at once. Leaving waits 100ms so the pointer can reach the bubble.

passthrough.ref: tooltip bubble (role=tooltip). Portaled and mounted only while open, so ref is null while closed.
passthrough.note: className keeps its original meaning: the wrapper around the trigger. style is kit-owned (positioning).

requirements: Escape hides an uncontrolled tooltip without closing a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Tooltip content available to assistive tech on focus
Hover after delay; focus shows at once; on touch a tap pins it and a tap elsewhere closes it
Pointer can move onto the bubble without it closing (100ms hide grace)
Portal the bubble to document.body so overflow never clips it

doNot: Do not hide required form labels in tooltips
Do not put links, buttons, or more than one short line in a Tooltip — use HelpPopover or Popover
snippet: <Tooltip content="Export includes all projects"><Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="sm">Export</Button></Tooltip>
